summary: The unnamable-type scan stops at top-level functions; Chain.worktreesBase's FlumePaths is unexported and unflagged

per.section: The package a chain loads through

acceptance: The export scan walks member signatures of reached types — excluding namespace members and `private` class members — and its unnamable set over this repo is empty.
tests: every type a member signature of a reached type names is exported from an entry module
notes: Known finding: `Chain.worktreesBase?: (paths: FlumePaths) => string` (src/Phase.ts) names FlumePaths (src/flumeApi.ts), which no entry module exports — a chain author cannot annotate that callback's parameter. The two exclusions are the design call: a `private` member carries no signature into the .d.ts, a namespace member is named through its namespace. Drained from the PUBLIC-SIGNATURE-TYPES note.
